item.summary: test(msteams): pin reply threading and reaction routing across conversation kinds (#127568) Table-driven regressions prove personal and group sends never carry a Teams thread suffix while channels preserve ;messageid, and that agent react actions route to the prepared Graph target per conversation kind with exact result payloads and inbound reaction event labels. Parity proof for Microsoft Lobster patches 0038/0026 via giodl73-repo/lobster-plugins-and-patches.
